description: Base MCP connects ChatGPT to your Base account for read-only access to your store data. Once connected via OAuth 2.1 (with your login and consent through Base's screen), ChatGPT can check account details, look up orders, review product listings, and check inventory levels — all without leaving the conversation. The connector only reads data; it cannot create, modify, or delete anything in your Base account.
